profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Nordstrom

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Story Inventory Inbound Outbound Team supporting the NAVI application

positions.title: Brown Design Workshop Monitor
positions.description:
- Certified to operate and provide procedural and safety training for a variety of wood-working and metal-working tools and machinery, as well as 3D printers, laser cutters, sewing machines, and electronic circuit boards, through comprehensive workshops
- Facilitate a collaborative and organized environment for members through check-ins, clean workspaces, and well-maintained machines

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Intern on the Supply Chain Tech Inbound Capability Team
- Engineered a generic automated smoke testing suite in Java utilizing Kafka consumers and producers to validate the connectivity between the applications of the Receiving Status Platform, a direct-receiving solution to be applied to all Nordstrom warehouses
- Deployed the application to Kubernetes on a Cronjob schedule in the Standard Pipeline, implemented Splunk alerts and New Relic metrics, and developed skills in working with following software: Postman, PostgreSQL, Jira, and Confluence
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Agile Project Management · Kafka · Collaborative Problem Solving · Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) · Pair Programming

positions.title: Chapter President
positions.description:
Chapter President for the Zeta Theta Chapter of Alpha Chi Omega
- Served as the chair of a 15-member executive board, as well as the liaison for Brown and the National Fraternity to conduct business revolving around university policies, programming, recruitment, finances, marketing, and philanthropy  
- Oversaw and organized philanthropic initiatives including several Domestic Violence Awareness tabling events, a Self-Defense Workshop fundraiser, and a new volunteering program to support Sojourner House, the local domestic violence shelter

positions.title: Vice President Public Relations and Marketing
positions.description:
VP PRM for the Zeta Theta Chapter of Alpha Chi Omega
- Developed and executed a marketing plan utilizing social media platforms to promote the chapter during the semester and recruitment

positions.title: Technical Theater Assistant
positions.description:
- Collaborated in crafting captivating set pieces and illuminating designs for two theater productions at Brown University
- Acquired proficient operation skills for woodworking machinery, including the miter saw, panel saw, table saw, nail gun, and jigsaw

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern
positions.description:
Intern on the Credit Team under the ETCCX Organization
- Improved the data extraction and access to accurate and near real-time online store Sales Performance Improvement Fund(SPIF) reports by  collaborating with the team’s manager to evaluate business requirements and interviewing the store manager for user input
- Established the first set of credit data in NAP (Nordstrom Analytical Platform) using Kafka, DynamoDB, Teradata, and DBeaver
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Agile Project Management · Kafka · Collaborative Problem Solving · Pair Programming

positions.title: Electrical Power System Engineer
positions.description:
A small group of Brown University students testing the limits of how quickly and efficiently a 3U CubeSat can be developed using parts that have never been to space before - using an $8 arduino processor and AA Energizer Batteries!

- Designed the 3U CubeSat’s battery pack and mechanical attachments to the chassis using Fusion 360 and rapid 3D printing prototyping 
- Directed the construction of the battery pack utilizing AA batteries, battery holders, PCBs, and diodes, all encapsulated in epoxy resin
- Orchestrated the integration of the battery pack with 4 distinct subsystems to complete the assembly of the satellite
positions.insights: Skills: Circuit Design · Epoxy · Autodesk Fusion 360 · Rapid Prototyping · Battery Design · Soldering · 3D Printing

positions.title: Teaching Assistant for Introduction to Object Oriented Programming (CSCI 0150)
positions.description:
- Conducted two 90-minute sections and labs every week for 20 students to delve into and practice implementing fundamental object-oriented programming design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and debugging techniques
- Hosted 4 weekly hours of Office Hours to help students with conceptual understanding and provide debugging support for 9 projects
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Object Oriented Design · Teaching · Leadership · Debugging

volunteerExperiences.description: The IRS Volunteer Income Tax Assistance/Tax Counseling for the Elderly (VITA/TCE) is a program where individuals volunteer to prepare taxes, free of charge, for individuals/families who fall under a certain threshold.  I volunteered at the Franciscan Community Development Center location.
